narr: A subtropical area of low pressure off the coast of the Carolinas moved inland, tracking west-northwest towards Charlotte and western North Carolina into the morning of the 17th of September. Rainfall amounts across central North Carolina ranged from 1 to 4 inches, which led to isolated flash flooding in Cumberland and Wake Counties.
